keyPhrases.text: Easy to get caught up in the spell of this Cabaret
The theater—sorry, the Kit Kat Club—is, indeed, beautiful
woefully miscast in a pivotal role
will bring you to very real tears

reasoning: Four-star review with strong praise for the production design, direction, and most performances. Contains some specific criticisms (miscasting of Blankson-Wood) but overall enthusiastic about the revival's atmosphere and effectiveness. Fits solidly in the 4/5 star range with more positives than negatives.
